entries.zh: 钓（垂钓、钓鱼）；〔疑〕若作“鉤”则为钓钩——西词 anzuelo 本指鱼钩
entries.en: fishhook (anzuelo); to angle, fish with hook and line
entries.notes: 汉字栏釣/鉤两疑：西词 anzuelo 本指鱼钩，两读皆通，故取中置信。

entries.zh: 钓钩、小鱼钩（钓仔）
entries.en: little fishhook; fishing hook (diminutive)
entries.notes: 同上条，釣仔/鉤仔两疑；“仔”为小称语缀。

entries.zh: 饵钓（装饵钓鱼；带饵的钓钩）
entries.en: baited fishhook; to fish with bait
entries.notes: 西栏 cabo 疑为 cebo（饵）之形近误写，与汉字“餌”正合。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉/闽/官三栏皆[空]，仅存西栏栏首记号“A. ante. P.”，无从释义。

entries.zh: 安插（安置、安顿：把人安插到某处或某职位）
entries.en: to install, place, settle (a person in a post or place); if read 安掛, to hang/fix
entries.notes: 汉字插/掛两疑；西栏“Baijvar”难解（疑为 colocar 类词之误写），以汉字“安插”为据。

entries.zh: 契；结契认亲——充当教父、结拜干亲（契父、契母之义）
entries.en: to stand godfather (padrinar); sworn/adoptive kinship, as 契父/契母 godparents

entries.zh: 充当教父、认干亲；代为说情〔汉字疑（艋/蜢/鴨）与西义不合，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to act as godfather; to intercede — Chinese gloss uncertain (character doubted: 艋/蜢/鴨)
entries.notes: 汉字三疑（艋/蜢/鴨）与西栏“教父/说情”义无直接对应，语义无法定夺，故低置信。

entries.zh: 灭、熄灭（自灭、熄掉）；西栏“A pagar.”疑为 Apagar 之误写
entries.en: to be extinguished, to die out (滅); headword “A pagar” (to pay) likely a miswriting of “apagar”
entries.notes: “滅”与前后 apagar 诸条义脉相贯；西栏若按“付钱”解则与汉闽官三栏全然不合，故取中置信。

entries.zh: 搧火（搧风/吹气以灭火）
entries.en: to blow on a fire (with wind) to put it out

entries.zh: 打火（打灭火、扑灭火）
entries.en: to beat out a fire, put out the fire
entries.notes: 旁注圈注“Lor pleng.”文字未明，系原件批注，不影响四栏互证。

entries.zh: 打花（拍灭火花/火苗）
entries.en: to beat out the flame (apagar)

entries.zh: 打熄、扑灭（字作“打失”；该语在闽南语中亦可指失落）
entries.en: to put out, extinguish (打失, lit. beat-lost); the same phrase in Hokkien also means “to lose”
entries.notes: 字面“打失”（失落）在闽南语为常语，此处承 apagar 词族读作“打熄”。

entries.zh: 吹灭蜡烛（打熄烛）
entries.en: to put out the candle
entries.notes: 官话栏中段残损（封存件标[残]），据西/汉/闽三栏互证释义。

entries.zh: 吹灭、吹熄（吹散扑灭）
entries.en: to blow out, extinguish by blowing (scatter and put out)
entries.notes: 西栏“boplard”难解（疑为误写），据汉/闽/官三栏“吹失”释义。

entries.zh: 火花了（火已熄灭、火灭掉了）
entries.en: the fire/flame has gone out (apagado)

entries.zh: 火熄啦（火已灭了）
entries.en: the fire has gone out (with exclamatory particle)
entries.notes: 汉字第三字疑“勝”当作“啦”（语气助词），与西栏“已熄”语气相合。

entries.zh: 救火（灭火、扑救火灾）
entries.en: to fight a fire, put out a blaze (save from fire)

entries.zh: 打（拍打、敲打）
entries.en: to beat, strike (with a paddle/stick; apalear)
entries.notes: 官话栏音节数较汉字单字为多（三对一），疑串行或另附短语。

entries.zh: 打骨头（痛打一顿、打个皮开肉绽）
entries.en: to thrash someone soundly (“beat his bones”, darle muy buenos palos)

entries.zh: 佔、占住（占据）；〔疑〕若作“櫃”则指橱柜，与西栏 aparador（橱柜）相合
entries.en: to occupy, take possession of (佔); if the character is 櫃, a cupboard/cabinet — matching Spanish aparador
entries.notes: 汉字佔/櫃两疑：闽栏读音合“佔”，西栏 aparador（橱柜）合“櫃”，官话栏音写未能对应。

entries.zh: 相人（相看人、品评人物相貌——为配对/择偶而相人）
entries.en: to appraise, size up people (physiognomy); one who pairs/matches people (apareador, pareado)
entries.notes: “ŷ. paread.”为缩写（疑 y pareado）；西栏“配对人”与汉字“相人”之关联系推断。

entries.zh: 英烈（英灵：亡故者/英烈之魂灵显现）
entries.en: to appear — the spirit/apparition of a deceased person (heroic spirit, 英烈); likewise, of his son
